annotations.title: List doctors and staff who take bookings

description: Use this when someone asks which doctors, nurses or assistants patients can book at their practice, or who takes an appointment. Returns up to 100 staff ids and display names for one practice (no contact details or roles). Not for staff holidays or sick days.
name: list_providers

providers.description: Ids and display names of staff with a doctor, nurse or assistant role, the ones the public booking page offers. Contact details, role records and clinical data are never returned.

id.description: Id to book with, as book_appointment takes it
